english_json: "Sanctify, O Lord, the gifts dedicated to Thee, and, by the intercession of blessed Francis, cleanse us from all stain of sin. Through our Lord."

"Grant, we beseech Thee, O almighty God, that we, who have known the fortitude of the glorious martyrs in bearing witness to Thee, may experience the fruit of their intercession with Thee. Through our Lord."

"Together with the reception of Thy sacrament, O Lord, may the blessed abbot N., protect us by interceding for us, that we may put into practice the virtues of his life and partake of the power of his intercession. Through our Lord."

"Grant, we beseech Thee, O almighty God, that, giving thanks for the favors we have received, we may, by the intercession of blessed N., Thy confessor and bishop, obtain blessings still greater. Through our Lord."

"O God, Who year by year dost renew the day of the consecration of this Thy holy temple, and dost ever bring us again in safety to the holy mysteries, hear the prayers of Thy people, and grant that whosoever entereth this temple to seek blessings may rejoice to obtain all that he seeketh. Through our Lord."
"May this communion, O Lord, cleanse us from guilt, and by the intercession of blessed N., Thy martyr and bishop, unite us in Him who is the heavenly medicine of our souls. Through our Lord."
"Sanctify O Lord the gifts we offer to Thee, and, blessed N., Thy martyr and bishop, interceding for us, appeased thereby, graciously look down on us. Through our Lord."
"Filled with the bounty of Thy divine gift, we beseech Thee, O Lord, that, by the intercession of the blessed N., Thy virgin and martyr, we may ever live in the partaking thereof. Through our Lord."
"We offer Thee, O Lord, the sacrifice of reconciliation, that Thou mayest mercifully forgive our sins and direct our wavering hearts. Through our Lord."
"May Thy holy things, O Lord, fill us with divine fervor, so that we may have pleasure alike in their performance and in their effect. Through our Lord."

"Having received the sacrament of salvation, O Lord, may we be profited unto the increase of our everlasting redemption. Through our Lord."
"May the sacrifice offered to Thee, O Lord, ever vivify and fortify us. Through our Lord."
